decision.decision: retain accepted source ambiguity; no forced ordeal rewrite
decision.evidence: Independently read all six full pairs in compiled MushroomEater_Entrance_3_6 order. Sadness and inability to manage alone precede the joint time journey/drink phrase; uncertainty and explicit impending danger precede the repeated invitation. There is no drink-item command. Persian retains joint participants, the country bent by the times, everyone drinking to the ambiguous referent, a future shared sip and probability. The adjacent danger warning is preserved. An additional explicit suffering fact or exclusive literal-drink assertion is unsupported. Exact coverage of every possible pun reading remains unproven.
